bincraftR

{bincraftR} provides a skeleton to build CRAN R package binaries in Linux. It does the heavy lifting behind the R package binary builds of devXY.

While this package helps with all the necessary actions, it requires additional infrastructure for building and hosting, especially on scale:

  • S3 storage
  • Target-architecture native servers (amd64, arm64)
  • Postgres DB for build metadata

As of now, the package only allows building CRAN packages, i.e. packages being mirrored on https://github.com/cran. There are no current plans to extend this right now. Also, the existence of a Postgres DB to store build metadata is a hard requirement at the moment.

Essential functions

The package covers the complete flow of building R package binaries:

  1. Clone package source from GitHub mirror
  2. Checkout a tag (=release)
  3. Install R package and system dependencies
  4. Build binary
  5. Upload binary to S3
  6. Archive possible older versions (to Archive/)
  7. Storing build metadata in a Postgres DB
